fields.description: Issue dated October 27, 1928, published in Miami, Florida and edited by Wyn R. Phillips. Articles and editorials cover a labor dispute involving movie theater operators and stagehands (including picketing and threats), criticism of city licensing enforcement against a theater producer, commentary on Florida election/appointment laws and local Republican politics, and civic complaints such as downtown parking behavior. Additional pieces discuss Prohibition-era bootlegging and informers, dry cleaning price competition, Coral Gables municipal controversies (including petitions regarding the superintendent of municipal transportation), local religious events, and community notes and advertisements.
